title: SplitLayout
description: Main content with an optional aside that splits beside it once the layout's own width reaches a breakpoint.

props.name: aside
asideWidth
props.description:
Requested aside width in pixels in split mode (the track is
`min(asideWidth, 50%)`); must be finite and positive, otherwise a RangeError
is thrown

props.name: collapseBelow
props.description:
Splits at container widths of at least 768px (`md`) or 1200px (`lg`) and
stacks below

props.name: gap
props.description:
Gap between the slots: numbers and numeric strings select spacing tokens,
other strings are CSS values

vars.name: --split-layout-align-items
vars.description: Vertical alignment of the main and aside columns (default: start)

translationResources.title: SplitLayout
translationResources.description: Main content with an optional aside that splits beside it once the layout's own width reaches a breakpoint.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A 320px aside splits at 768px of container width and stacks below; main stays first in DOM order.

options.title: Width, breakpoint and gap
options.description: asideWidth, collapseBelow="lg" (1200px) and gap customize the split.

SplitLayoutProps.aside: Secondary content after the main slot; null, undefined and false omit it (0 is valid content)
SplitLayoutProps.asideWidth: Aside width in pixels in split mode (track is min(asideWidth, 50%)); must be finite and positive
SplitLayoutProps.collapseBelow: Splits at container widths of at least 768px (md) or 1200px (lg) and stacks below
SplitLayoutProps.gap: Gap between the slots (spacing token or CSS value)

cssVars.--split-layout-align-items: Vertical alignment of the main and aside columns (default: start)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Main content in the default slot, secondary content in the aside slot. The aside splits beside main once the layout is at least 768px wide, and stacks after it below.

options.title: Width, breakpoint and gap
options.description: aside-width sets the aside column (capped at 50%), collapse-below="lg" waits for 1200px before splitting, gap uses spacing tokens. Drag the slider to resize the container.

slots.aside: Secondary content, after main in reading order.
